io.reader

Class ReadWorkbook

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.reader.ReadWorkbook
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ExcelReadable, Readable, java.lang.AutoCloseable, java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.String[]>
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    UpdateWorkbook

    public class ReadWorkbook
extends java.lang.Object
implements ExcelReadable
    Reads Excel workbooks in binary XLS and XML-based XLSX formats using Apache POI.

    Implements ExcelReadable to provide worksheet selection, cell access, and row iteration. The reader must be opened using open() before accessing worksheet contents and should be closed after use to release underlying resources. A try-with-resources statement is recommended.

    Change log:
    • 4 November 2021 - Initial creation.
    • 7 October 2026 - Refactored package location to io.reader, implemented ExcelReadable and migrated exception handling to TabularDataException.
    Since:
    4 November 2021
    Version:
    0.4
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs
